_readme: Single source of truth for categories and listings. Later this can be replaced by a published Google Sheet (CSV) with the same columns. status: available | sold | hidden. images are paths without size suffix/extension; the site loads <path>-600.webp, <path>-1000.webp and <path>.jpg.

items.title: Neelam Two-Tier Steel Tiffin
items.description: A classic Indian stainless steel tiffin by Neelam (since 1972). Two stacking compartments, a lid with a fold-down carry handle, and a clip that locks all three together. Plastic-free, dishwasher-friendly steel, sized for one good lunch. Several available.
